tagline: Enter Thailand. Skip the hard part.

industry: Market Entry Consulting / Local Operating Partner / Thailand Brand Launch
mission: We give international brands the infrastructure, the local team and the operational base to enter Thailand. No setup from scratch. Real revenue from day one.
positioning: The only Bangkok-based operating partner that gets your brand live in Thailand in under 2 weeks — no Thai company registration, no legal setup, no wasted months.

services.title: Brand Representation & Action Plan
services.tagline: Enter the market with a clear roadmap — not guesswork.
services.description: Market research, competitive mapping, brand adaptation and a full go-to-market roadmap built around your specific product, price point and audience.

services.title: Cloud Kitchen Operations
services.tagline: Your food brand live in Bangkok in under two weeks.
services.description: Operate your food brand from our fully equipped Bangkok building — cloud kitchen, office and showroom included. No Thai company registration required.

services.title: Commercial & Distribution Services
services.tagline: Open doors that would otherwise take years to build.
services.description: Local commercial team working your accounts every day — retail, HORECA and B2B partnerships across Bangkok and Thailand.

audience_primary.name: The International F&B Brand
audience_primary.pain: Wants to test the Bangkok F&B market but fears legal setup, finding the right kitchen, activating delivery platforms and managing daily ops from abroad.
audience_primary.desire: Be live on GrabFood, Foodpanda and LINE Man in 2 weeks without registering a Thai company.

audience_secondary.name: The International Lifestyle / Consumer Brand
audience_secondary.pain: Has validated the brand at home but doesn't know how to enter Thailand — who to talk to, which channels work, how to adapt the product.
audience_secondary.desire: A single trusted partner who handles the entire market entry — strategy, operations, commercial team.

differentiator: Infrastructure already built. Team already here. Your brand live in 2 weeks.
